Ridgewood Terrace | Pinnacle Realty

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a sophisticated, high-conversion landing page for a luxury open house event promoting a single property at "4821 Ridgewood Terrace" in Scottsdale, AZ. The page should feel aspirational and polished — designed to drive RSVPs and showcase the property's best features. It's hosted by a real estate agent inviting prospective buyers.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Pinnacle Realty" in a clean serif font with a geometric house icon
- Links: Property Details, Gallery, Features, Open House, Agent
- Right side: "RSVP for Open House" CTA (solid #1E3A5F navy blue)
- White background, minimal, sticky on scroll
- Mobile: simplified with logo + RSVP button only, hamburger for other links

2. HERO SECTION
- Full-width hero image: twilight exterior photo of a modern desert luxury home — warm interior glow, saguaro cactus silhouettes, dramatic sky
- Overlay content (bottom-left aligned):
  - Badge: "Open House This Weekend"
  - Address: "4821 Ridgewood Terrace, Scottsdale, AZ 85262"
  - Price: "$2,450,000" in large display font
  - Key stats row: "5 Bed · 4.5 Bath · 4,820 sq ft · 0.75 Acre Lot · Built 2021"
  - Two CTAs: "RSVP Now" (solid navy) + "View Gallery" (outline white)
- Thin gold (#C9A96E) accent line separating hero from content
- Subtle Ken Burns zoom animation on the background image

3. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS (icon grid)
- Section headline: "At a Glance"
- 8 highlight cards in 4x2 grid (2x4 on mobile):
  - "5 Bedrooms" — bed icon — "Primary suite with private balcony and mountain views"
  - "4.5 Bathrooms" — bath icon — "Spa-inspired primary bath with soaking tub and rain shower"
  - "Chef's Kitchen" — utensils icon — "Wolf & Sub-Zero appliances, waterfall quartz island, butler's pantry"
  - "Infinity Pool" — waves icon — "Heated saltwater pool with spa, fire bowls, and desert views"
  - "3-Car Garage" — car icon — "Oversized bays with EV charging stations and epoxy floors"
  - "Smart Home" — wifi icon — "Control4 system: lighting, climate, security, audio, shades"
  - "Home Office" — monitor icon — "Dedicated office with built-in cabinetry and glass doors"
  - "Guest Casita" — house icon — "Detached 450 sq ft studio with kitchenette and private entrance"
- Each card: icon in gold circle, feature name bold, one-line description below
- Background: #F8F6F3 (warm linen)

4. PHOTO GALLERY (masonry lightbox)
- Section headline: "Step Inside"
- Masonry grid of 12 photos:
  - Exterior front — desert modern architecture, clean lines, stone and stucco
  - Great room — double-height ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, linear fireplace
  - Kitchen — wide shot showing island, appliances, open to dining
  - Kitchen detail — close-up of quartz countertop, brass hardware, wine fridge
  - Primary bedroom — king bed, desert view through sliding glass, neutral tones
  - Primary bathroom — freestanding tub, frameless shower, marble tile
  - Backyard — infinity pool at twilight, fire bowls lit, outdoor kitchen
  - Outdoor kitchen — built-in grill, bar seating, pergola with fans
  - Home office — built-in desk, shelving, glass french doors
  - Guest casita exterior — private entrance, small patio with seating
  - Dining room — 10-seat table under statement chandelier
  - Garage — 3 bays, EV chargers visible, epoxy floor
- Click any photo to open full-screen lightbox with left/right navigation
- Photo counter: "1 of 12"
- Background: white

5. FLOOR PLAN & PROPERTY DETAILS
- Section headline: "The Details"
- Two-column layout:
  - Left: stylized floor plan illustration (simplified architectural layout) with room labels
  - Right: detailed spec table
- Property specs:
  - Living area: 4,820 sq ft
  - Lot size: 0.75 acres (32,670 sq ft)
  - Year built: 2021
  - Style: Contemporary Desert Modern
  - Construction: Stucco and natural stone
  - Roof: Flat with parapet, TPO membrane
  - Flooring: Porcelain tile, white oak hardwood
  - Cooling: 3-zone HVAC, 16 SEER
  - Heating: Forced air + radiant in-floor (primary bath, kitchen)
  - Water heater: Tankless (2 units)
  - HOA: $285/month (gated community, common area maintenance)
  - Property tax (2025): $14,280/year
  - School district: Scottsdale Unified — Saguaro High School
  - MLS#: AZ-2026-48210
- "Download Full Spec Sheet (PDF)" link
- Background: white

6. NEIGHBORHOOD & LOCATION
- Section headline: "The Neighborhood"
- Interactive map showing property location with nearby points of interest:
  - Pinnacle Peak Trail — 2.1 miles — hiking icon
  - Scottsdale Quarter (shopping/dining) — 4.3 miles — shopping bag icon
  - Grayhawk Golf Club — 3.8 miles — golf icon
  - Whole Foods Market — 5.1 miles — grocery icon
  - HonorHealth Scottsdale — 6.2 miles — hospital icon
  - Scottsdale Airport — 8.7 miles — plane icon
- Community highlights below map:
  - "Gated community with 24/7 security and maintained desert landscaping"
  - "Walking trails throughout the community connect to Pinnacle Peak preserve"
  - "Average home value in Ridgewood Terrace: $2.1M–$3.5M"
- Background: #F8F6F3 (warm linen)

7. OPEN HOUSE EVENT DETAILS & RSVP
- Section headline: "Join Us for the Open House"
- Event card (centered, prominent):
  - Date: Saturday, April 4, 2026
  - Time: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  - Address: 4821 Ridgewood Terrace, Scottsdale, AZ 85262
  - "Light refreshments and guided tours every 30 minutes"
  - "Mortgage pre-approval consultations available on-site with Desert Financial CU"
- RSVP form below:
  - Fields: Full Name, Email, Phone, Preferred Time Slot (dropdown: 11 AM, 11:30 AM, 12 PM, 12:30 PM, 1 PM, 1:30 PM, 2 PM, 2:30 PM), "Are you working with an agent?" (Yes/No radio), Message (optional textarea)
  - Submit button: "Reserve My Spot" (solid navy #1E3A5F)
  - Below form: "Can't make it? Request a private showing" link
- Background: white with subtle gold border accent around the event card

8. MORTGAGE CALCULATOR (interactive)
- Section headline: "Estimate Your Payment"
- Calculator inputs:
  - Home price: $2,450,000 (pre-filled, editable)
  - Down payment: $490,000 (20% default, slider adjustable 5%–50%)
  - Loan term: 30 years (toggle: 15 / 20 / 30)
  - Interest rate: 6.75% (editable)
  - Property tax: $14,280/year (pre-filled)
  - HOA: $285/month (pre-filled)
  - Insurance: $3,600/year (estimated)
- Output:
  - Estimated monthly payment: $14,890 (large, bold)
  - Breakdown pie chart: Principal & Interest, Property Tax, HOA, Insurance
  - "Get Pre-Approved →" link to partner lender
- Background: #F8F6F3

9. AGENT PROFILE
- Section headline: "Your Listing Agent"
- Two-column layout:
  - Left: professional headshot photo of agent
  - Right: agent details
    - "Victoria Reeves" — Broker Associate, Pinnacle Realty
    - Credentials: "ABR, CRS, SRES · 14 years in Scottsdale luxury market"
    - Bio: "Victoria has closed over $180M in North Scottsdale residential sales. Named Scottsdale's Top Producer 2023, 2024, and 2025. She specializes in desert modern architecture and golf community properties."
    - Stats row: "320+ homes sold" | "$180M+ total volume" | "4.9★ (218 reviews)"
    - Contact: (480) 555-0192 · victoria@pinnaclerealty.com
    - Social: Instagram, LinkedIn
    - Two CTAs: "Call Victoria" (solid navy) + "Send a Message" (outline)
- Background: white

10. SIMILAR LISTINGS (related properties)
- Section headline: "You May Also Like"
- 3 property cards in a row:
  - "7930 E Raintree Dr" — $1,895,000 — 4 bed, 3.5 bath, 3,640 sq ft — photo thumbnail — "View Listing"
  - "22614 N Pinnacle Peak Rd" — $2,780,000 — 5 bed, 5 bath, 5,210 sq ft — photo thumbnail — "View Listing"
  - "10585 E Crescent Moon Dr" — $3,150,000 — 6 bed, 6 bath, 6,800 sq ft — photo thumbnail — "View Listing" — Badge: "Just Listed"

- Mobile: horizontal scroll or stack

11. FOOTER
- 3 columns: Property, Resources, Contact
- Property: Gallery, Floor Plan, Neighborhood, Mortgage Calculator
- Resources: Home Buying Guide, Pre-Approval, Moving Checklist, School Ratings
- Contact: Victoria Reeves, (480) 555-0192, victoria@pinnaclerealty.com, Pinnacle Realty — 8280 E Raintree Dr Suite 100, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
- Legal: "Equal Housing Opportunity · MLS# AZ-2026-48210 · Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed"

- "© 2026 Pinnacle Realty. All rights reserved."

Design: Sophisticated, aspirational, conversion-focused. Primary: #1E3A5F (navy blue), secondary: #C9A96E (gold), accent: #FFFFFF (white). Backgrounds: white alternating with #F8F6F3 (warm linen). Typography: Playfair Display for headings (elegant serif), Inter for body text. Cards with 8px border-radius, subtle shadows. Photography should be professionally shot real estate style — twilight exteriors, bright interiors, wide angles. Gold accent lines and borders for luxury feel. Generous whitespace throughout.

Responsive: On mobile, property highlights become 2x4 grid. Photo gallery becomes horizontal scroll carousel with dots. Floor plan is full-width scrollable. Map becomes static with list of distances below. RSVP form is full-width. Mortgage calculator stacks inputs vertically. Agent profile stacks photo above details. Similar listings scroll horizontally. Floating "RSVP" button at bottom of screen on mobile. Navigation simplifies to logo + RSVP CTA + hamburger.
